name: PEVN / Express / Vue 3 / Capacitor
description: Document-store stack reusing the Stack-18 server spine on a different client technology: Express 4 + Mongoose 8 backend (strict allow-listed models, cookie sessions, worker-thread bcrypt, documents CRUD, real in-process Mongo in tests) implemented and tested (vitest unit + supertest integration); Vue 3 + Vite 7 web client on a shared API-client layer implemented and tested; Capacitor 6 thin shell authored over the same shared layer but UNVERIFIED (no Android SDK).
